mechanics.claim: Basic attacks generate Fury on-hit, at a reduced rate against minions and a different reduced rate against wards/jungle plants.
mechanics.quote: '''Rek'Sai''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|fury|{{as|25 Fury}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}, reduced to {{as|{{ap|25*0.16}}|Fury}} per hit against {{tip|minions}}, and to {{as|{{ap|25*0.2}}|Fury}} per hit against {{tip|ward|wards}} and [[jungle plants]].

mechanics.claim: Abilities other than Prey Seeker (Queen's Wrath) generate Fury on hitting at least one unit; Prey Seeker generates no Fury against non-champions.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Prey Seeker|Rek'Sai}}'' does not generate {{as|Fury}} against non-{{tip|champions}} hit.

mechanics.claim: Fury decays out of combat, reducing available Fury for empowered abilities.
mechanics.quote: After 8 seconds of being [[out of combat]], she loses {{as|20 Fury}} per second.

mechanics.claim: Burrowing consumes current Fury over time to heal Rek'Sai, stopping early if she reaches full health or fully consumes her Fury.
mechanics.quote: she consumes her current {{as|Fury}} over 3 seconds to {{tip|heal}} for {{pp|0 to 100|0 to 100 by 5|type=Fury|key=%|color=Fury}} of {{as|{{pp|9 + (20-9)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} '''maximum''' health}}, stopping once fully consumed or she reaches {{sti|health|{{as|full health}}}}.

mechanics.claim: When Fury is automatically consumed while already Burrowed (no transformation), the healing buff refreshes every second while Fury remains above 25, extending the heal to 6 seconds at 100 Fury (noted as a bug).
mechanics.quote: the healing buff will refresh every second while she has/maintains over {{as|25 Fury}}.{{bug|2}} This causes the healing to last 6 seconds at {{as|100 Fury}}.
